record.title: Notice of Counterclaim - Claim against Plaintiff(s) (Small Claims)
record.source_description: To provide notice to the plaintiff(s) or plaintiff's attorney that a counterclaim or cross complaint has been filed. The notice must be mailed on the same day the counterclaim or cross complaint is filed. Voluntary form.
